description: Lists hotels a given points balance can reach for one night, ranked by how good the redemption is against that program's own norm rather than a flat cents-per-point scale. Fits a traveler who says what they hold, e.g. "I have 300k Hyatt points". The balance is supplied by the caller and is not stored. Only published chart or sampled award prices count; nothing is estimated. Returns a Markdown table of up to `limit` hotels (name, destination, points, value grade, score), or a sentence saying nothing priced fits the budget.

program.description: Loyalty program, e.g. "World of Hyatt", "Hilton Honors", "Marriott Bonvoy".

name: find_award_stays
title: Find award stays
